karnataka_police_fir.name: Karnataka State Police FIR Open Records Dataset
karnataka_police_fir.description: 1.6M anonymized Karnataka Police FIR records including police station jurisdiction, IPC sections, crime category, and incident timestamps.

ncrb_crime_in_india_summary.citation: National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB), Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India (Dataful.in)
ncrb_crime_in_india_summary.intended_use: Spatio-temporal Poisson crime forecasting and trend analysis
